rules.statement: A grant to a man and his descendants can create a fidei commissum if it shows an intention to tie up the properties for multiple generations, especially with a prohibition against alienation.
rules.supporting_quote: "In 9 S. C. C. 33 a Court of three Judges held that a grant of property 'to A, her children, and their children in perpetuity, which shall not be sold, mortgaged, or gifted to any one, ' was a good fidei commissum."
